hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '^git push'; then echo '🧪 Running tests before push...' >&2 && npm test 2>&1 || printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Tests failed — fix failures before pushing."}}'; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Running test suite before git push...
